verified_apis.family_note: PHP's bundled XML extensions DOMDocument/Dom\XMLDocument (ext/dom), SimpleXML (ext/simplexml), XMLReader (ext/xmlreader) and xml_parser_create (ext/xml, libxml2 SAX compatibility layer) all parse through libxml2. Packagist wrappers of these APIs (sabre/xml, veewee/xml, symfony/dom-crawler, mtownsend/xml-to-array, laravie/parser and similar) share this family and are not independent parser engines.

verified_apis.runtime: PHP 8.5.12 CLI (source build, --disable-all --with-libxml --enable-dom) with source-built libxml2 2.15.4
verified_apis.input: in-memory string (control bytes passed to loadXML with LIBXML_NONET); DOMDocument::load() file/URL input is not counted
verified_apis.observable_result: loadXML builds a libxml2 tree; walking it gives a prefixed root {urn:parsarium:catalog}catalog with a default-namespace child scope, 5 elements in Clark notation, 2 namespace declarations (DOMElement::getAttributeNames, libxml2 nsDef), a prefixed attribute {urn:parsarium:catalog}lang, entity-decoded text and a CDATA section, depth 3; the second control gives 7 elements, 3 declarations including the xmlns="" undeclaration, char-reference-decoded text and depth 4
verified_apis.family_note: Same parser family as the XMLReader::XML entry: ext/dom hands the string to libxml2 (xmlCreateMemoryParserCtxt / xmlParseDocument with the SAX2 tree builder). It is a second standard API over the same engine, not an independent parser.

verified_apis.runtime: PHP 8.5.12 CLI (source build, --disable-all --with-libxml --enable-simplexml) with source-built libxml2 2.15.4
verified_apis.api: simplexml_load_string(string $data, ?string $class_name = SimpleXMLElement::class, int $options = 0, string $namespace_or_prefix = "", bool $is_prefix = false)
verified_apis.input: in-memory string (control bytes passed to simplexml_load_string with LIBXML_NONET); simplexml_load_file() file/URL input is not counted
verified_apis.observable_result: simplexml_load_string returns the root SimpleXMLElement over a libxml2 tree; walking it with SimpleXML methods only (xpath('*') and xpath('@*') for document order, getNamespaces(false) with a self::*[namespace-uri()] check for the element namespace, getDocNamespaces(false, false) for each element's own declarations, string casts for text) gives a prefixed root {urn:parsarium:catalog}catalog with a default-namespace child scope, 5 elements in Clark notation, 2 namespace declarations, a prefixed attribute {urn:parsarium:catalog}lang, entity-decoded text and CDATA text, depth 3; the second control gives 7 elements, 3 declarations including the xmlns="" undeclaration, char-reference-decoded text and depth 4
verified_apis.observable_limits: SimpleXML exposes no text-node or comment/PI accessor: (string) of an element concatenates its direct text and CDATA, so character-data runs split by child elements, comments or PIs inside one element are merged and ordered before the element's children. Comments, PIs and the XML declaration are not exposed. Element namespace URIs and document-order children/attributes come from SimpleXMLElement::xpath. Neither control has non-whitespace mixed content, so the summary equals the expat oracle on both.
verified_apis.family_note: Same parser family as the XMLReader::XML and DOMDocument::loadXML entries: ext/simplexml hands the string to libxml2 (xmlReadMemory with the SAX2 tree builder) and wraps the root element. It is a third standard API over the same engine, not an independent parser.

unverified_documented_apis.reason: ext/xml SAX API over libxml2; not built or run in this pilot.

limit: Two small UTF-8 namespace-aware controls without DOCTYPE verify XMLReader::XML, DOMDocument::loadXML and simplexml_load_string for this PHP 8.5.12/libxml2 2.15.4 build; they do not establish DTD, external entity, non-UTF-8 encoding, XML 1.1, validation or DOMDocument::load()/simplexml_load_file() file-input behaviour.
runtime_note: Each verified API has its own PHP 8.5.12 source build: XMLReader with --enable-xmlreader, DOMDocument with --enable-dom, SimpleXML with --enable-simplexml; all link the same source-built libxml2 2.15.4.
